works.title: Meme Machine / Meme Warfare Strategy
works.description: Strategic framework for creating emotionally resonant counter-messaging and memes targeting political opponents. Uses mockery, humiliation, and exploited fears to shift narrative control and expose authoritarian tactics. Includes tactics for targeting enablers vs marks, creating persona-based false-flag content, and building iconic mythology around political opposition.
works.quote: That just motivates me even more to work on the meme machine. Literally, the only way to confront that strategy is to beat him at his own game—own the headlines with mockery and humiliation

works.title: Villain Archetypes Framework / Mythology
works.description: Research and development of archetypal villainous characters across history, literature, and mythology (oral traditions, Bible, epics, modern). Goal is to build enduring narrative framework for depicting political opposition as timeless archetypal evil, distinguishing between ephemeral tools and eternal cultural truths.
works.quote: In structuring the vision for memes, I want to create an iconic mythology to help it endure... By rooting modern right-wing villains in timeless archetypes, you do three things at once: 1. Make them culturally legible 2. Build narrative durability 3. Create psychological resonance
